levels.description_zh: 让载具越过终点。轮子接地，风扇朝右，先让它动起来。
levels.description_en: Reach the finish. Put wheels underneath and point a fan right to get moving.

levels.description_zh: 坡道后有一道裂谷。减轻落势，或借一次弹跳，把载具送到对岸。
levels.description_en: A gap follows the ramp. Soften the fall or use a spring to reach the far side.

levels.description_zh: 途中迎风。增加推进，也要让受力平衡，别把自己掀翻。
levels.description_en: A headwind lies ahead. Add thrust, balance its leverage and keep the machine upright.
